The definition of free speech is strange.

For one thing the original idea of free speech had to do with governments who would crack down on people for dissent. It's closely tied to the idea of free press. Over time it has been warped to state that anyone can say anything they want. This is where the nightmare begins.

I cant threaten someone without them losing their sense of security. Do i have the right to do that to them just because I can say whatever I want?

I cant spread hateful messages without creating an unwelcome environment for the hated. Do i have the right to do that?

Generally allot of free speech advocates focus on dissent. Without dissent we can't have an open and free society. That's why its important. Whether your right to make those around you feel unsafe and unwelcome is up in the air.
